includes_scope: Exact Git snapshot of repository branch at snapshot_head, including Governing, immutable RawSourceCorpus, Foundation, Architecture, DetailedDesign, Registers, State, README and then-current backup metadata.
secrets_included: No secret inclusion was introduced by Phases 1–4; repository is documentation-only in this workflow. A physical ZIP was not available for independent archive-content scan in this environment.
limitation: The execution environment could not resolve/download GitHub archive content or clone github.com from the container, so the required physical ZIP could not be materialized and SHA-256 verified. The exact Git snapshot remains recoverable through snapshot_head/tree/blob SHAs and immutable_archive_url.
gate_effect: Physical pre-development ZIP is not a readiness blocker by explicit owner direction. No session-created ZIP is claimed. Future release/deployment/production backup requirements remain separately governed.
